import urllib.request, urllib.parse, json
queries=[
 'Salvador MDT',
 '"Modelo Digital de Terreno" Salvador',
 'Salvador MDE FMLF',
 'Salvador elevacao FMLF',
 'Salvador terrain SIRGAS 2000',
 'Salvador curvas de nivel FMLF',
]
for q in queries:
    url='https://www.arcgis.com/sharing/rest/search?'+urllib.parse.urlencode({'q':q,'f':'json','num':100})
    req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30) as r: data=json.load(r)
    print('QUERY',q,'TOTAL',data.get('total'))
    for it in data.get('results',[]):
        title=it.get('title',''); typ=it.get('type',''); owner=it.get('owner',''); tags=it.get('tags',[])
        txt=' '.join([title,owner,' '.join(tags)]).lower()
        if any(k in txt for k in ['salvador','mdt','terreno','elev','fmlf','mde','curva']):
            print('ITEM',it.get('id'),typ,owner,repr(title),'URL',it.get('url'))
